questions.q:
Identify the correct pair having amino acid (A) and the hormone (B) that is iodinated derivative of the amino acid (A).
(T and Y represent one letter code for amino acids)
questions.explain: The one-letter code for the amino acid Tyrosine is Y, and Threonine is T. Thyroxine is a thyroid hormone that is an iodinated derivative of the amino acid Tyrosine. Insulin is a peptide hormone not derived from a single iodinated amino acid. Thus, the correct pair is Y and Thyroxine.
